name: agentprivacy-entry-kit-coherence
title: Entry Kit Coherence
card: Audit and align City, Labs and landing agent discovery instructions with actual MCP capabilities and deployment limits.
brief:
Audit and align City, Labs and landing agent discovery instructions with actual MCP capabilities and deployment limits.

Treat mages_city/site/skill.md as the canonical detailed entry. Labs site/skill.md, discovery.md and llms.txt and landing public/skill.md and llms.txt should point to it, not maintain contradictory full copies. Preserve each site's own purpose.

The capability source is agentprivacy-mcp/lib/experience-overview.json; the City site/experience-overview.json must match it. Verify every listed tool against the actual MCP tools/list response. Distinguish implemented local tools, observed portal state, pending live adapters and design proposals. A running farm row is not verified extension control; passing fixtures are not deployment.

Check the whole path: learning, existing key, selected disclosure, invitation approval/signing, MyTerms/task/VRC verification, exact scoped action, real receipt and private journey fold. Keep public graph edges distinct from private perspective and current access.

Verify local links, inventory equality, relevant MCP tests, City static-front checks and TypeScript for landing changes. Preserve operational records. Prepare sync from the can
